answer: Put signature stroke dynamics on a tablet at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 504 aliases would need 504 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The wander sits in the mechanism itself, the ocean sits in the price of faking it, and the signal sits in the record no template can forge. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
